notificationPreferences.subtitle: Choose what reminders feel right for you. These are designed to support, never pressure.

frequencyHints.balanced: Core reminders plus gentle contextual support.
frequencyHints.supportive: All available reminders including streak and re-engagement nudges.

calmFollowups: A gentle check-in after intense moments settle
reengagement: Supportive nudge if you haven't visited in a while

notificationPreferences.membershipNote: Membership reminders are never sent during high distress or crisis moments.
